api.config_recovered: The settings file was unreadable: settings were reset to their defaults (the old file is kept next to it, with a .broken-… name).
api.terms.accept_first: Accept the terms of use first to use DodoTopia.
api.terms.accepted: Thank you! Terms of use accepted.
api.terms.outdated: This version of the terms is no longer in force: read the text shown again.
api.draw.import_first: Import an image in the Drawing activity first
api.cook.configure_first: Set up cooking first ("Set up cooking" button, Cooking activity)
api.cook.restart: Cooking stopped: start it again to serve {n, plural, one {# stove} other {# stoves}}.
api.import.added: {n, plural, one {# song imported} other {# songs imported}}
api.import.skipped: {n, plural, one {# file skipped, it is not a .mid} other {# files skipped, they are not .mid files}}: {names}
api.import.nothing: Nothing imported: DodoTopia reads .mid and .midi files. Skipped: {names}
api.busy: A preview or a playback is already running
api.compat.semitones_expected: a value in semitones is expected
api.compat.omit_on: Out-of-range notes are now skipped (no more octave folding).
api.compat.fold_on: Out-of-range notes are replayed one octave away again.
api.test_key.no_keys: This instrument has no key set up.
api.test_key.not_focused: {name} is not in the foreground: switch back to the game during the delay ({delay} s) after clicking.
api.test_key.denied: Windows refused to send the key ({code}).{admin, select, true {} other { Run DodoTopia as administrator (the game probably is).}}
api.test_key.sent: Key "{label}" sent to the game: you should have heard a note.
api.log.none_draw: No log yet: start a drawing first
api.log.none_cook: No log yet: start cooking first
api.log.none: No log yet for this feature
api.keyboard.reverted: {layout} keyboard: {names} {n, plural, one {goes} other {go}} back to "to verify" (no key removed).
api.layout.stop_first: Stop playback before changing the layout.
api.layout.confirm_custom: {name} has custom keys: confirm to replace them with "{layout}".
api.layout.applied: {name}: layout "{layout}" ({n, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}}). Choose the same one in the game.
api.profile.not_json: Profile refused: this is not a valid JSON file.
api.profile.stop_first: Stop playback before importing a profile.
api.profile.nothing_usable: Profile refused: no usable key and no known layout.
api.profile.imported: Profile imported for {name}: to verify in the game{rejected, plural, =0 {} one { (# entry skipped)} other { (# entries skipped)}}.
wizard.intro: Open the instrument in Heartopia before starting: choosing here equips nothing in the game.
wizard.stop_first: Stop playback before setting up the keys.
wizard.bind_first: Assign at least one key first.
wizard.key_not_injectable: This key cannot be sent to the game.
wizard.layout.prefilled: Keys of "{layout}" proposed: profile documented by a source, not verified on this computer.
wizard.layout.to_capture: {n, plural, one {# note to record} other {# notes to record}}: press the game key for each note, no key is guessed for this instrument.
wizard.test.stopped_no_more: Test stopped: no other key was sent.
wizard.test.stop_first: Stop playback before testing the keys.
wizard.test.go: Switch to Heartopia: DodoTopia is about to press these keys.
wizard.test.heard_note: What did you hear in the game?
wizard.test.incomplete: The test did not complete: run it again before answering.
wizard.answer.partial_full: Quick test passed on {n, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}}. Full validation: {rest, plural, one {# assignment remains} other {# assignments remain}} to verify.
wizard.answer.quick: Quick test passed: partial check, only the keys that were sent have been verified.
wizard.answer.wrong: These keys did not produce what was expected: fix the assignments, then run the test again.
wizard.save.closed: The setup wizard is no longer open: nothing was saved.
wizard.save.stop_first: Stop playback before saving the keys.
wizard.save.bind_first: Assign at least one key before saving.
update.toast.installing: Installing, DodoTopia is about to close…
api.online.share_rights: Tick “I have the right to share this file” to share it.
api.gallery.png_too_big: Image too large for the gallery (512 KB max).
api.gallery.png_invalid: Unreadable drawing image: convert it again.
api.gallery.reported: Report sent: thanks, a moderator will take a look.
